git checkout -q -b perfproof/rolling-sum && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
s=open('rolling.py').read()
i=s.index("    out = np.empty")
s=s[:i]+'''    csum = np.empty(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    csum[0] = 0
    np.cumsum(values, dtype=np.int64, out=csum[1:])
    return csum[width:] - csum[: n - width + 1]
'''
s=s.replace("Runs in O(n) time with a running total.","Runs in O(n) time from prefix sums; int64 wraparound in the prefix\n    sums cancels in the differences, so only the window sums must fit.")
open('rolling.py','w').write(s)
EOF
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
python - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, subprocess
from rolling import rolling_sum
old=subprocess.run(["git","show","main:rolling.py"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
ns={};exec(old,ns)
r=np.random.default_rng(1)
for n,w in [(10,3),(10,10),(10,11),(1,1),(0,1),(1000,7)]:
    v=r.integers(0,1000,n,dtype=np.int64)
    assert (ns['rolling_sum'](v,w)==rolling_sum(v,w)).all()
print("match")
EOF
git commit -qam "rolling_sum: use prefix sums instead of a Python loop" && git rev-parse --short HEAD; git checkout -q main; git status --short
